name: test-hud
description: Test runs at a glance: passing over total on the hint line under the prompt, colored by the result, a sparkline of failures across runs, the failing tests grouped by file, and toasts when the suite turns green or a test turns flaky

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Track test runs: the tests line, the pane and the toasts. Off keeps only the /test-hud command, which turns it back on. /test-hud on and off change it too; /test-hud hide keeps it on but silent

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Draw nothing by itself, as hide does, and keep the command and the pane. /pad quiet on and off set it in every mod at once. Errors, permission requests and the agent's questions are never hidden

regressionToast.title: Toast when tests turn red
regressionToast.description: Also show a toast when a runner turns red right after a green run

flakyToast.title: Toast when a test turns flaky
flakyToast.description: Show one toast when a run leaves a test flaky: it failed, passed and failed again in the command's last 10 runs. Each test is announced once per session

keepHistory.title: Keep runs across sessions
keepHistory.description: Keep the last runs per project in the plugin's store, so the next session in the same project starts with them
